newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Storage sets 1 mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Storage sets 1 mln share buyback.

text.p: Silicon Storage Technology Inc. said Wednesday it board of directors has approved a stock repurchase of up to one million of its common shares.
The company said in a statement the repurchase program is expected to continue until December 15, 1997, unless extended or shortened by the board.
"This stock repurchase plan reflects the board's confidence in our company's strategy for diversification and future growth," said President and Chief Executive Bing Yeh.
"We believe the stock repurchase is a good long-term investment of our cash on hand," he added.
At the end of June Silicon Storage had about 25.2 million shares outstanding.
